title: Version Your Specs Like Code: Never Lose a Change
description:
Your AI spec deserves a git history! 🕰️

✅ Keep SPEC.md in git like any code file
✅ One rule change = one commit, with a spec: prefix
✅ Read the history with git log and undo a bad rule with git revert

Day 10 of Spec-Driven AI, the last one in this series! Next up: the new series AI Debugging, Day 1: Paste the Stack Trace, Get the Fix.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

#shorts #ai #aicoding #git #coding #programming #aitools
comment: One commit per rule or one big commit: which do you pick? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: git revert makes a new commit that undoes an old one, so your history stays intact.
